title: Train Announcement
synopsis: Do you have trouble hearing what the announcement says when you ride the bullet train in China? Today’s lesson contains many common phrases you’ll hear on the train.

fullText.simplified:
动车广播

各位旅客，你们好，欢迎乘坐本次列车。为了方便您的旅行，下面为您介绍一下乘车事项。
    由于列车运行速度较快，您在接开水或冲泡方便面时请不要接得过满，以免列车晃动，开水溢出，烫伤自己与他人。小茶桌不要放置过重物品。您在使用卫生间后，注意按冲水按钮，冲洗便池，不要将杂物丢进便池内。每张座椅的下部均装配有220V交流插座，请您注意用电安全。请大家妥善使用，并爱护车内设备设施。
    动车组列车全列禁止吸烟，禁止携带易燃易爆危险物品，列车运行中，禁止触摸车厢两端的红色紧急按钮和火灾按钮。请不要倚靠车门和两节车厢连接处，以免发生意外。
    带小孩的乘客请照看好您的小孩，不要让小孩在车厢内奔跑、吵闹、攀爬座椅、手扶门缝等。幼儿哭闹时，请您将小孩带到车厢连接处哄劝，尽量保持车厢内安静，共同维护良好乘车环境。
    您在上下车时，注意站台与列车之间的缝隙，列车到站停车时间很短，没有到站的旅客，请不要下车散步或吸烟。
    如果您因时间仓促没有来得及购买车票，请找列车长办理补票手续。
    根据铁路安全管理条例的规定，列车严格执行车票识别制乘车，旅客的车票、身份证件和乘车员必须一致，违反上述规定，按无票处理。无票乘车及越站的旅客，或持二等车票乘坐一等车的旅客，将补加收已乘区间应补票价50%的票款。感谢您的配合，祝您旅途愉快！
fullText.traditional:
動車廣播

各位旅客，你們好，歡迎乘坐本次列車。為了方便您的旅行，下面為您介紹一下乘車事項。
    由於列車運行速度較快，您在接開水或沖泡方便麵時請不要接得過滿，以免列車晃動，開水溢出，燙傷自己與他人。小茶桌不要放置過重物品。您在使用衛生間後，注意按沖水按鈕，沖洗便池，不要將雜物丟進便池內。每張座椅的下部均裝配有220V交流插座，請您注意用電安全。請大家妥善使用，並愛護車內設備設施。
    動車組列車全列禁止吸煙，禁止攜帶易燃易爆危險物品，列車運行中，禁止觸摸車廂兩端的紅色緊急按鈕和火災按鈕。請不要倚靠車門和兩節車廂連接處，以免發生意外。
    帶小孩的乘客請照看好您的小孩，不要讓小孩在車廂內奔跑、吵鬧、攀爬座椅、手扶門縫等。幼兒哭鬧時，請您將小孩帶到車廂連接處哄勸，儘量保持車廂內安靜，共同維護良好乘車環境。
    您在上下車時，注意站台與列車之間的縫隙，列車到站停車時間很短，沒有到站的旅客，請不要下車散步或吸煙。
    如果您因時間倉促沒有來得及購買車票，請找列車長辦理補票手續。
    根據鐵路安全管理條例的規定，列車嚴格執行車票識別制乘車，旅客的車票、身份證件和乘車員必須一致，違反上述規定，按無票處理。無票乘車及越站的旅客，或持二等車票乘坐一等車的旅客，將補加收已乘區間應補票價50%的票款。感謝您的配合，祝您旅途愉快！

sentences.english: Train Announcement

sentences.simplified: 各位旅客，你们好，欢迎乘坐本次列车。
sentences.traditional: 各位旅客，你們好，歡迎乘坐本次列車。
sentences.pinyin: gè wèi lǚ kè nǐ men hǎo huān yíng chéng zuò běn cì liè chē

sentences.simplified: 为了方便您的旅行，下面为您介绍一下乘车事项。
sentences.traditional: 為了方便您的旅行，下面為您介紹一下乘車事項。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le fāng biàn nín de lǚ xíng xià miàn wèi nín jiè shào yí xià chéng chē shì xiàng
sentences.english: Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, welcome aboard this train.
The following is a brief introduction to this train's precautions for the sake of ensuring a pleasant journey.

sentences.simplified: 由于列车运行速度较快，您在接开水或冲泡方便面时请不要接得过满，
sentences.traditional: 由於列車運行速度較快，您在接開水或沖泡方便麵時請不要接得過滿，
sentences.pinyin: yóu yú liè chē yùn xíng sù dù jiào kuài nín zài jiē kāi shuǐ huò chōng pào fāng biàn miàn shí qǐng bú yào jiē de guò mǎn

sentences.simplified: 以免列车晃动，开水溢出，烫伤自己与他人。
sentences.traditional: 以免列車晃動，開水溢出，燙傷自己與他人。
sentences.pinyin: yǐ miǎn liè chē huàng dòng kāi shuǐ yì chū tàng shāng zì jǐ yǔ tā rén
sentences.english: Since the train moves at a fast speed, please do not overfill when you take hot water or make instant noodles, ..

sentences.simplified: 小茶桌不要放置过重物品。
sentences.traditional: 小茶桌不要放置過重物品。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo chá zhuō bú yào fàng zhì guò zhòng wù pǐn
sentences.english: .. to avoid spilling hot water and scalding yourself or others in case the train sways.

sentences.simplified: 您在使用卫生间后，注意按冲水按钮，冲洗便池，不要将杂物丢进便池内。
sentences.traditional: 您在使用衛生間後，注意按沖水按鈕，沖洗便池，不要將雜物丟進便池內。
sentences.pinyin: nín zài shǐ yòng wèi shēng jiān hòu zhù yì àn chōng shuǐ àn niǔ chōng xǐ biàn chí bú yào jiāng zá wù diū jìn biàn chí nèi
sentences.english: Do not place too heavy items on the tray table.

sentences.simplified: 每张座椅的下部均装配有220V交流插座，请您注意用电安全。
sentences.traditional: 每張座椅的下部均裝配有220V交流插座，請您注意用電安全。
sentences.pinyin: měi zhāng zuò yǐ de xià bù jūn zhuāng pèi yǒu 5 jiāo liú chā zuò qǐng nín zhù yì yòng diàn ān quán
sentences.english: After using the bathroom, make sure you press the flush button to flush the bowl, and do not throw trash into the bowl.

sentences.simplified: 请大家妥善使用，并爱护车内设备设施。
sentences.traditional: 請大家妥善使用，並愛護車內設備設施。
sentences.pinyin: qǐng dà jiā tuǒ shàn shǐ yòng bìng ài hù chē nèi shè bèi shè shī
sentences.english: A 220V AC outlet is mounted under each seat. Please be careful to use electricity in a safe manner.
We ask everyone to please take care of the train's equipment and facilities and use them in a proper manner.

sentences.simplified: 动车组列车全列禁止吸烟，禁止携带易燃易爆危险物品，
sentences.traditional: 動車組列車全列禁止吸煙，禁止攜帶易燃易爆危險物品，
sentences.pinyin: dòng chē zǔ liè chē quán liè jìn zhǐ xī yān jìn zhǐ xié dài yì rán yì bào wēi xiǎn wù pǐn

sentences.simplified: 列车运行中，禁止触摸车厢两端的红色紧急按钮和火灾按钮。
sentences.traditional: 列車運行中，禁止觸摸車廂兩端的紅色緊急按鈕和火災按鈕。
sentences.pinyin: liè chē yùn xíng zhōng jìn zhǐ chù mō chē xiāng liǎng duān de hóng sè jǐn jí àn niǔ hé huǒ zāi àn niǔ
sentences.english: Smoking is forbidden in all cars of the train. It is forbidden to bring flammable or explosive dangerous items.

sentences.simplified: 请不要倚靠车门和两节车厢连接处，以免发生意外。
sentences.traditional: 請不要倚靠車門和兩節車廂連接處，以免發生意外。
sentences.pinyin: qǐng bú yào yǐ kào chē mén hé liǎng jié chē xiāng lián jiē chù yǐ miǎn fā shēng yì wài
sentences.english: When the train is in motion, it is forbidden to press the red emergency button or the fire button located in both ends of the carriage.
Please do not lean against the train door or the connection point between two train cars, in order to avoid accidents.

sentences.simplified: 带小孩的乘客请照看好您的小孩，
sentences.traditional: 帶小孩的乘客請照看好您的小孩，
sentences.pinyin: dài xiǎo hái de chéng kè qǐng zhào kàn hǎo nín de xiǎo hái

sentences.simplified: 不要让小孩在车厢内奔跑、吵闹、攀爬座椅、手扶门缝等。
sentences.traditional: 不要讓小孩在車廂內奔跑、吵鬧、攀爬座椅、手扶門縫等。
sentences.pinyin: bú yào ràng xiǎo hái zài chē xiāng nèi bēn pǎo chǎo nào pān pá zuò yǐ shǒu fú mén fèng děng
sentences.english: We ask passengers traveling with small children to please look after your children.

sentences.simplified: 幼儿哭闹时，请您将小孩带到车厢连接处哄劝，
sentences.traditional: 幼兒哭鬧時，請您將小孩帶到車廂連接處哄勸，
sentences.pinyin: yòu ér kū nào shí qǐng nín jiāng xiǎo hái dài dào chē xiāng lián jiē chù hǒng quàn
sentences.english: Do not allow the children to run inside the train, make noise, climb their seat or support their hand on the door seam.

sentences.simplified: 尽量保持车厢内安静，共同维护良好乘车环境。
sentences.traditional: 儘量保持車廂內安靜，共同維護良好乘車環境。
sentences.pinyin: jǐn liàng bǎo chí chē xiāng nèi ān jìng gòng tóng wéi hù liáng hǎo chéng chē huán jìng
sentences.english: If your infant is crying, we ask that you take the child to the section between cars to comfort, ..
.. to keep the carriage as peaceful as possible, and cooperating in upholding a pleasant traveling environment.

sentences.simplified: 您在上下车时，注意站台与列车之间的缝隙，
sentences.traditional: 您在上下車時，注意站台與列車之間的縫隙，
sentences.pinyin: nín zài shàng xià chē shí zhù yì zhàn tái yǔ liè chē zhī jiān de fèng xì

sentences.simplified: 列车到站停车时间很短，没有到站的旅客，请不要下车散步或吸烟。
sentences.traditional: 列車到站停車時間很短，沒有到站的旅客，請不要下車散步或吸煙。
sentences.pinyin: liè chē dào zhàn tíng chē shí jiān hěn duǎn méi yǒu dào zhàn de lǚ kè qǐng bú yào xià chē sàn bù huò xī yān
sentences.english: When getting on or off the train, mind the gap between train and platform.
The train only stops briefly at each station, so we ask passengers who have not yet reached their stop to not go for a walk or go smoking.

sentences.simplified: 如果您因时间仓促没有来得及购买车票，请找列车长办理补票手续。
sentences.traditional: 如果您因時間倉促沒有來得及購買車票，請找列車長辦理補票手續。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nín yīn shí jiān cāng cù méi yǒu lái de jí gòu mǎi chē piào qǐng zhǎo liè chē zhǎng bàn lǐ bǔ piào shǒu xù

sentences.english: If you did not have time to buy a train ticket, please find a conductor to pay the compensation ticket cost.

sentences.simplified: 根据铁路安全管理条例的规定，列车严格执行车票识别制乘车，
sentences.traditional: 根據鐵路安全管理條例的規定，列車嚴格執行車票識別制乘車，
sentences.pinyin: gēn jù tiě lù ān quán guǎn lǐ tiáo lì de guī dìng liè chē yán gé zhí xíng chē piào shí bié zhì chéng chē

sentences.simplified: 旅客的车票、身份证件和乘车员必须一致，违反上述规定，按无票处理。
sentences.traditional: 旅客的車票、身份證件和乘車員必須一致，違反上述規定，按無票處理。
sentences.pinyin: lǚ kè de chē piào shēn fèn zhèng jiàn hé chéng chē yuán bì xū yí zhì wéi fǎn shàng shù guī dìng àn wú piào chǔ lǐ
sentences.english: Following the rules of the Railroad Safety Management Guidelines, this train strictly enforces ticket segmentation.

sentences.simplified: 无票乘车及越站的旅客，或持二等车票乘坐一等车的旅客，
sentences.traditional: 無票乘車及越站的旅客，或持二等車票乘坐一等車的旅客，
sentences.pinyin: wú piào chéng chē jí yuè zhàn de lǚ kè huò chí èr děng chē piào chéng zuò yī děng chē de lǚ kè
sentences.english: For each passenger's ticket, your identification must match the name on the ticket, and a violation of this rule is considered traveling without a ticket.

sentences.simplified: 将补加收已乘区间应补票价50%的票款。
sentences.traditional: 將補加收已乘區間應補票價50%的票款。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng bǔ jiā shōu yǐ chéng qū jiān yīng bǔ piào jià 5 de piào kuǎn
sentences.english: Passengers who travel without a ticket, have travelled past their ticket destination, or sit in a first class car with a second class ticket, ..

sentences.simplified: 感谢您的配合，祝您旅途愉快！
sentences.traditional: 感謝您的配合，祝您旅途愉快！
sentences.pinyin: gǎn xiè nín de pèi hé zhù nín lǚ tú yú kuài
sentences.english: .. shall compensate for the distance travelled without a ticket, and must pay 50% extra for the fare.

raw.synopsis: Do you have trouble hearing what the announcement says when you ride the bullet train in China? Today’s lesson contains many common phrases you’ll hear on the train.
sentence_translations: Train Announcement
Dear Ladies and Gentlemen, welcome aboard this train.
The following is a brief introduction to this train's precautions for the sake of ensuring a pleasant journey.
Since the train moves at a fast speed, please do not overfill when you take hot water or make instant noodles, ..
.. to avoid spilling hot water and scalding yourself or others in case the train sways.
Do not place too heavy items on the tray table.
After using the bathroom, make sure you press the flush button to flush the bowl, and do not throw trash into the bowl.
A 220V AC outlet is mounted under each seat. Please be careful to use electricity in a safe manner.
We ask everyone to please take care of the train's equipment and facilities and use them in a proper manner.
Smoking is forbidden in all cars of the train. It is forbidden to bring flammable or explosive dangerous items.
When the train is in motion, it is forbidden to press the red emergency button or the fire button located in both ends of the carriage.
Please do not lean against the train door or the connection point between two train cars, in order to avoid accidents.
We ask passengers traveling with small children to please look after your children.
Do not allow the children to run inside the train, make noise, climb their seat or support their hand on the door seam.
If your infant is crying, we ask that you take the child to the section between cars to comfort, ..
.. to keep the carriage as peaceful as possible, and cooperating in upholding a pleasant traveling environment.
When getting on or off the train, mind the gap between train and platform.
The train only stops briefly at each station, so we ask passengers who have not yet reached their stop to not go for a walk or go smoking.
If you did not have time to buy a train ticket, please find a conductor to pay the compensation ticket cost.
Following the rules of the Railroad Safety Management Guidelines, this train strictly enforces ticket segmentation.
For each passenger's ticket, your identification must match the name on the ticket, and a violation of this rule is considered traveling without a ticket.
Passengers who travel without a ticket, have travelled past their ticket destination, or sit in a first class car with a second class ticket, ..
.. shall compensate for the distance travelled without a ticket, and must pay 50% extra for the fare.
Your cooperation is appreciated, and we wish you a pleasant journey.
